water_bottle_omar: Consistently at coffee_table_l1. Repeatedly missed by assuming kitchen spots (dish_rack_k1, kitchen_table_k1). Do not check kitchen first. Check coffee_table_l1 immediately.

mug_omar: Consistently at coffee_table_l1. Repeatedly missed by assuming kitchen spots (kitchen_table_k1). Do not check kitchen first. Check coffee_table_l1 immediately.

glasses_omar: Highly variable but recently consistent at coffee_table_l1. Missed nightstand_b1 (09:07) when it was at coffee_table_l1. Previous misses included bathroom_shelf_ba1. Do not assume bedroom or bathroom. Check coffee_table_l1 first, then nightstand_b1.

book_omar: Consistently at coffee_table_l1. Repeatedly missed by assuming couch_l1 or bed_b1. Do not assume living room seating or bedroom. Check coffee_table_l1 immediately.

charger_omar: Previously missed at coffee_table_l1 (09:55) when assumed at desk_b1. No new misses today, but pattern holds. Check coffee_table_l1 first, then entry spots.

glass_omar: Distinct from other Omar items. Found at cupboard_k1 (22:59) when assumed at kitchen_table_k1. Do not apply coffee_table_l1 rule to this item. Check cupboard_k1 and kitchen_table_k1.

General: Coffee_table_l1 is the dominant location for Omar’s personal items (mug, water bottle, glasses, book, charger). Stop assuming kitchen, bedroom, or desk locations for these specific items. Always check coffee_table_l1 first. Exception: glass_omar is in the kitchen (cupboard_k1), not the living room.
